description: Send a message to other agents. to: an agent name or id, a selector ('project=apparish' reaches every agent on apparish), or '*' for every agent on the machine. Returns a delivery receipt per recipient. await_reply=true: block until the first reply (or timeout_seconds) and return it.

await_reply.description: Block until the first reply arrives and return it. Implies expect_reply; priority defaults to urgent.

expect_reply.description: Tell recipients you are waiting for an answer.

priority.description: urgent: lands mid-turn. normal (default): next turn, wakes an idle agent. fyi: no wake, waits in the inbox.

timeout_seconds.description: With await_reply: how long to wait. Default 120.

name: send
title: Send a message
